summary: Scala: Store a list. Read pets.tail.head.
introduction: List holds items in order. head reads the first item. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Install Scala CLI. Save each example as lesson.scala and run scala run lesson.scala. These examples use Scala 3 syntax.

blocks.title: Store a list

blocks.text: List puts cat first. head returns that first item.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: head fails on an empty list; headOption is safer when it may be empty.
